scripts.build: npm run build -w @travel-growth-inspiration/contracts && npm run build -w travel-nova-api && npm run build -w travel-nova-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @travel-growth-inspiration/contracts && npm run typecheck -w travel-nova-api && npm run typecheck -w travel-nova-web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @travel-growth-inspiration/contracts && npm test -w travel-nova-api && npm test -w travel-nova-web && npm test -w @travel-growth-inspiration/mcp
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @travel-growth-inspiration/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w travel-nova-api" "npm run dev -w travel-nova-web"
